verdict.rationale: The 01 is described as an open-source platform. Its server, the 'brain', runs on the user's own computer, ships in Light and Livekit variants, and can be customized through local profiles, including the language model. That clearly delivers self-hosting of the core product. Missing for 10: detailed self-host installation/deployment documentation in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of running it self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The 01 is an open-source platform for intelligent devices
The brain of the 01 system that runs on your computer.
Livekit Server: Full-featured for higher processing power devices.
Customize behavior, language model, system message, and more by editing profiles in the `software/source/server/profiles` directory.
